final: WITH j AS (SELECT t.observstation AS station, o.lunarstage AS phase, t.bandusagepct AS bw FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation), s AS (SELECT station, phase, AVG(bw) AS avg_bw, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM j GROUP BY station, phase), p AS (SELECT phase, AVG(avg_bw) AS avg_of_avgs, SUM(cnt) AS total_cnt FROM s GROUP BY phase), tot AS (SELECT SUM(total_cnt) AS grand FROM p) SELECT p.phase, p.avg_of_avgs, p.total_cnt, p.total_cnt * 1.0 / tot.grand AS share FROM p JOIN tot ON tot.grand IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p.phase
